razer - hammerhead v3 x hyperspeed wirel.name: Razer - Hammerhead V3 X HyperSpeed Wireless Multi‑Platform In-Ear Gaming Earbuds – 2.4 GHz & Bluetooth 5.3, Up to 35 Hr Battery - Black
razer - hammerhead v3 x hyperspeed wirel.description: Wireless Multi Platform Gaming Earbuds. The Razer Hammerhead V3 X HyperSpeed is designed for gamers who need ultra low latency audio across multiple devices without sacrificing portability or convenience. Ultra Low Latency HyperSpeed Wireless. Powered by Razer HyperSpeed Wireless, these gaming earbuds deliver gaming grade 2.4 GHz audio with instant response, keeping sound and action perfectly aligned during fast paced gameplay on PC, PlayStation 5, Steam Deck, and mobile devices. Dual Wireless Connectivity with Smart Switching. Switch effortlessly between HyperSpeed Wireless and Bluetooth 5.3 using Razer SmartSwitch. Whether you’re gaming at your desk or taking calls on the go, the transition is smooth and interruption free. HyperSpeed Charging Case with Built In Receiver. The compact HyperSpeed case doubles as both a charging solution and a wireless receiver. Simply connect the case to your setup to unlock dedicated 2.4 GHz performance—no extra dongles required. Extended Battery for All Day Play. Enjoy up to 35 hours of total battery life, with up to 10 hours on the earbuds and an additional 25 hours from the case. USB C passthrough charging lets you keep playing while powering up.THX Spatial Audio and Custom Controls. On PC, activate THX Spatial Audio in Razer Synapse to experience 7.1.4 surround sound for greater positional accuracy and immersion on Windows 11 systems. Fine tune settings, gestures, and touch controls using Synapse 4 or the Razer Audio App, with an on case LED bar providing clear charging and pairing status. Built for Daily Use. An IPX4 water resistant design protects against sweat, rain, and everyday use, while intuitive touch controls and LED indicators make adjustments fast and effortless wherever you play.
